messages:
Alex_Sales: Hey team — Sparrow (prospect) asked for a POC run focused on throughput + tail latency. They want: sustained 600 qps, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 350ms for text-generation (seq len ~256). Need: load plan, rough cost estimate, and answers for KMS and SOC2 questions. Who can own the runbook and timing?

Maria_Solutions: I can own the run coordination. Quick sketch:
- Stage: hosted sandbox cluster (dedicated nodes if we need capacity)
- Model: gpt-3.5-medium-16k-quant (match customer budget)
- Workload: 50% short (64 tokens), 50% long (256 tokens)
- Ramp: 0 -> 600 qps over 10 min, hold 30 min, spike to 900 qps for 3 min
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/s, GPU util, outage incidents

Maria_Solutions: Load generator (suggested):
```bash
# uses wrk-like tool + our client
./bench-client --endpoint https://api.redwood.test --model gpt-3.5-medium-16k-quant \
  --concurrency 150 --qps 600 --payload-template templates/chat_256.json \
  --duration 2400s --report /tmp/sparrow-run.json
```

Sophie_Eng: Couple of notes:
- Quantized model helps cost but expect ~5-8% p99 uplift vs float16 in worst-case sequences.
- Enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts — should cut tokens/service by ~15% and reduce p95.
- If they care about strict p99, we should pin to Dedicated pool (single-tenant GPUs) during the test.

Sophie_Eng: Perf guess (hosted, dedicated nodes, one shot):
- 4x A100-80GB dedicated: sustained 600 qps with p95 ~90-120ms, p99 ~280-360ms depending on request mix.
- Cost estimate: $X/hour for dedicated nodes + token usage. I'll draft numbers after we pick exact model variant.

Jamal_Ops: Ops checklist / blockers:
- VPC peering for their network? They asked for private vpc option in security Q. If yes, add 3 days for infra + approvals.
- KMS: They want HSM-backed key wrap for prompt storage. We currently support KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and HSM via partner — need security signoff.
- Quotas: We need to bump rate limits on the sandbox tenant to 1k qps to allow spikes. Can do today if Alex confirms.

Alex_Sales: @Maria_Solutions please own the runbook. @Sophie_Eng can you confirm the dedicated node count and a rough $/hr delta vs hosted? Jamal — can you flag the KMS/HSM answer to security and estimate approval time? Customer wants test next Tue morning PST.

Maria_Solutions: Taking it. I'll prepare a runbook (smoke, ramp, soak, spike, rollback) and link the test dashboard. Aim to have draft by EOD tomorrow.

Sophie_Eng: Will validate numbers end of day. Short note: if they insist on conservative p99 SLAs we should propose canary fallback to a cheaper model under burst to protect latency — otherwise cost balloons.

Jamal_Ops: Security timeline: KMS standard integration answer = immediate (we can share docs). HSM-backed = 5-7 business days (procurement + add-on). I'll ping security and post the questionnaire excerpts we can answer today.

security-bot: New security ticket created: SEC-2026-113 Sparrow POC — assigned to @security-team. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/SEC-2026-113

Alex_Sales: Great. Two action items for now: (1) Maria — runbook + bench command by EOD tomorrow, (2) Jamal — confirm KMS vs HSM timelines and post the short answers for their security questionnaire. I'll loop in AEs and the prospect once runbook is ready. :thumbsup:

Maria_Solutions: Noted. Will include suggested metrics dashboard (Grafana panels: latency histogram, p99 trend, GPU util) and a sample slack alerting rule for p99 > 400ms.

Sophie_Eng: If anyone wants to pre-run a micro-smoke today at 50 qps to verify model load path, I can schedule a 30m slot.

Alex_Sales: Let's do the smoke now if possible. Maria, Sophie — coordinate and I'll tell the customer we validated plumbing.

Maria_Solutions: I'll DM scheduling. Thanks all :)
